info.description: Postman collection for Purchasing foundation APIs. Covers login, purchase invoice list/create/view/update/cancel, receipt draft/create/confirm, and inventory balance/ledger checks after receipt confirmation. Purchase invoice save does not move stock; confirmed receipts post inventory ledger and balance rows.
